changelog: v42a is a FIX REVISION of v42, not a new upgrade: it corrects the new System Health 'Config Check' row, which showed 'Entity not found' on v42 units because Home Assistant derives entity ids from the sensor NAME, not its unique id, and v42 named the sensor 'Cytech Config Check' (producing sensor.cytech_config_check) while the row referenced sensor.cytech_integrity_status. The sensor is renamed to 'Cytech Integrity Status' so its id is the one the dashboard uses; the dashboard row itself is unchanged. v42a also carries the same v42 content for units coming from v41 or older, AND v40/v41 for units coming from v39 or older see the description below. v42 makes a corrupted configuration.yaml self-healing, and not just at boot: the system keeps a rolling known-good snapshot of configuration.yaml (refreshed after every clean check -- at boot and every 4 hours while running), and if the live file is ever found corrupt it is replaced by the snapshot with the broken copy saved as configuration.yaml.corrupt.<timestamp>, HA restarts (runtime corruption is repaired the same day it happens, before the next update's restart could land the system in HA recovery mode), and the integrity alert says so. Two safety properties: the snapshot is only refreshed after the configuration actually parsed clean, so a corrupted state can never be snapshotted as 'good'; and no restore happens unless the snapshot itself parses, so there is no restore loop. Integrity alerts are now also emailed (support@cytech.biz always, plus the owner's registered address per the v41 rule), and the System Health dashboard shows a Config Check row with the last running check result. For v39 or older, v42a also carries v40 and v41: the owner's address field is 'My Email for Alerts', a Register press always reports its status on screen (empty field: 'Enter your email first, then press Register.'), a successful Register sends ONE confirmation mail To: the owner Cc: support@cytech.biz, alerts ALWAYS go to support@cytech.biz with the owner's registered address copied automatically (no Cytech/Me/Both selector), and units with mail configured but no owner registered yet show a small non-blocking hint. Nothing is lost if the owner never registers: support@cytech.biz always receives every alert.
